# Inert historical passive-operation fixtures

The `.txt` files retain exact UNISSUED source bytes for the adapter's inverse-hash regression tests. Tests only read them and substitute synthetic bindings; they never execute these producers or observers. Review JSON is explicitly synthetic, preserving only the historical scope and source hashes. It grants no approval or browser access.

PROVENANCE.json records file digests and original review digests. These historical pilot operations retain their original targets, guards and October 28, 2026 cutoff. They are not a recurring unrestricted navigation interface. Fresh-checkout tests require no `.ecc` state, credentials, browser, or AWS account.
